material_capabilities.name: dataset preprocessing orchestration
material_capabilities.observed_behavior: Loads dataset-specific rows, normalizes lead order for selected datasets, changes sampling rate when needed, segments signals, rejects NaN/Inf outputs, and persists waveform/report metadata.

material_capabilities.name: explicit lead-order mapping
material_capabilities.observed_behavior: Declares a target lead order and dataset-specific source lead orders, then constructs reorder indices.

material_capabilities.name: sampling-rate normalization
material_capabilities.observed_behavior: Uses cubic interpolation when source and target sampling frequencies differ.

material_capabilities.name: fixed-sample segmentation
material_capabilities.observed_behavior: Splits processed signals into non-overlapping fixed-length sample segments and repeats the report for each segment.

material_capabilities.name: WFDB record ingestion
material_capabilities.observed_behavior: Uses wfdb.rdsamp and carries source sampling frequency forward.
material_capabilities.target_reason: Canonical target already contains target-owned WFDB signal support from DONOR-001.

material_capabilities.name: base dataset adapters
material_capabilities.observed_behavior: Dataset-specific ingestion and report extraction for seven ECG datasets.

material_capabilities.name: research dataset mapping
material_capabilities.observed_behavior: Maps external research text/question-answer datasets onto preprocessed ECG segment paths.

material_capabilities.name: PTB-XL report translation
material_capabilities.observed_behavior: Invokes google/translategemma-12b-it through a Transformers pipeline to translate reports from German to English.

material_capabilities.name: ECG Byte BPE tokenizer training
material_capabilities.observed_behavior: Min-max normalizes signals, quantizes to a 26-symbol alphabet, trains BPE, and persists tokenizer vocab/merges via pickle.

material_capabilities.name: checked-in trained tokenizer artifacts
material_capabilities.observed_behavior: Three serialized trained tokenizer artifacts are tracked in Git.

material_capabilities.name: dataset publication and QA utilities
material_capabilities.observed_behavior: Research publication, statistics, seeding, file, and visualization support.

notable_repository_risks: Root MIT license does not govern all vendored/dataset-derived content.
Vendored ECG-QA subtree includes its own CC-BY-4.0 license and hundreds of JSON/CSV/TSV source-data artifacts.
Three trained tokenizer pickle artifacts lack separately established training-data provenance/license for target import.
PTB-XL translation depends on an unpinned external model checkpoint/license and GPU execution.
Default DATA_DIR is coupled to ../ECG-Bench/ecg_bench/data rather than a neutral configurable path.
Base preprocessing swallows per-record exceptions and counts skips without structured failure provenance.
Cubic interpolation and fixed-sample segmentation are implementation choices, not established target clinical truth.
Committed __pycache__/pyc files are non-source repository noise.
